context: Hi there, im here to help you find a movie!
Awesome thank you!
What kind of movie genre do you like?
Romantic, War, Horror, and some comedy or drama.
Oh okay, same here those are good genres. What was the last movie you watched, did you like it?

Book is amazing and they done a perfect job on acting the movie. yes i would be, thank you
Im excited to hear that haha now I want to watch it! Have you seen a dogs purpose yet?
yes please do great movie and loved how they got the dog to play a different dog and role every time, dont want to spoil it and yes that would be great!
A dogs way home would be a great movie to watch if you havent already. Since you have seen both of the other 2 movies above this one was great compared to those!

youre very welcome!
Do you know who plays in the movie?

Yes I do, Ashley Judd and Jonah Hauer-King play 2 of the main characters and Bryce Howard too, Bryce is who voices for the dog Bella thats trying to get back home after breaking out of the window and chasing a squirrel only to get lost!
Okay, I have seen the trailer for this movie but never watched it yet. Looks very good!
Its a very cute movie, I watched it with my husband and enjoyed it just as much as I did a dogs purpose :)
I am sure my children will love this movie as well. They loved the other ones.
Yes I hope they do too, dog movies are the best in my opinion! The endings always make me happy when everything ends up being okay.
Yes an animal movie is usually a hit with my children. Thank you so much for recommending this movie to me!
Youre very welcome!

context.content: What kind of movies do you enjoy watching?
Hey there! I'm a big fan of romance movies. They usually have a good story and nice chemistry between the leads.
That's great! I think you'll enjoy "When a Man Loves a Woman" from 1994. It has a classic romance storyline with strong performances.
Sounds interesting! Can you tell me more about it? Like the plot and the actors involved?
"When a Man Loves a Woman" is about a wealthy man who falls in love with a woman from a poor background. The lead actors are Steve Martin and Diana Keen. Their on-screen chemistry is amazing.
Wow, that sounds like a compelling story. I like the idea of a classic romance with strong performances. Do you know if it's available on streaming platforms?
It seems like a perfect match for me. I appreciate the detailed info. [END]
